job.title: Business Development & Sales Executives — Water Technology
job.description:
The Market Right Now
Canada's massive water infrastructure pipeline isn't just creating demand for
engineers and PMs — it's fuelling a boom in water technology sales. With billions
flowing into treatment upgrades, municipalities and utilities are buying, and the
companies selling solutions need experienced people to win the work. This is the
single most active hiring category in Canadian water right now.

What We're Placing
W3 North America is recruiting commercial leaders and sales guns for the water
technology companies driving innovation in treatment, distribution, and asset
management. Our roles include Business Development Managers and Directors,
Sales Managers, Territory Managers, Account Managers, and Technical Sales
professionals — working with equipment manufacturers, technology vendors, and
solution providers.

Who You Are
  • Proven track record in B2B sales or business development, ideally within water, wastewater, environmental, or infrastructure markets
  • Strong technical fluency — you can hold your own in conversations about treatment processes, membranes, instrumentation, or infrastructure assets
  • Experience managing territories, key accounts, or building new market presence
  • Commercially driven with a genuine interest in the water sector

Register Your Interest
W3 North America is Canada's first recruitment agency built exclusively for the water
and wastewater sector. We have daily conversations with companies looking to scale
their operations in the country. Register today and let us connect you with your next
commercial leadership role.

job.title: Engineers — Water & Wastewater
job.description:
The Market Right Now
Canada needs 50,000 engineers to deliver its water and wastewater infrastructure
pipeline — and the talent gap is only widening. Process engineers are the number
one bottleneck nationally, and SCADA/controls specialists are in acute shortage. If
you're a water or wastewater engineer, your skills have never been more valuable.

What We're Placing
W3 North America is recruiting engineers across every discipline that keeps
Canada's water moving. Our roles span process engineering, design engineering,
civil engineering, environmental engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical
engineering, and SCADA/instrumentation & controls — from intermediate through
principal and team-lead levels.

Who You Are
  • Engineering degree with experience in water, wastewater, or related environmental infrastructure
  • Working toward or holding a P.Eng designation (or equivalent provincial licence)
  • Skilled in one or more areas: process design, hydraulic modelling, treatment systems, SCADA/PLC programming, detailed design, or environmental compliance
  • Motivated by technically challenging work on projects that genuinely matter

Register Your Interest
W3 North America is Canada's first specialist water and wastewater recruiter. We
speak your language and understand your career. Register now to access
opportunities matched to your discipline.

job.title: Project Managers — Water Infrastructure
job.description:
The Market right now.
Canada is in the middle of the largest water infrastructure investment cycle in its
history. With over $5 billion in active capital projects — from Toronto's $34B capital
plan to Vancouver's billion-dollar tunnel programs and dozens of WTP/WWTP
upgrades coast to coast, there is a lot of opportunity for Project Managers and
Engineers country wide.

Who we’re working with
W3 North America is connecting PMs with the projects that are reshaping Canada's
water and wastewater infrastructure. We're recruiting across construction project
management, design project management, program management, and delivery
management roles with leading contractors, consultancies and technology providers.

Who You Are
  • 5+ years of project management experience in water, wastewater, or civil infrastructure
  • Background in construction delivery, design management, or capital program oversight
  • Comfortable managing multimillion-dollar budgets, schedules, and stakeholder relationships
  • PMP, P.Eng, or equivalent credentials preferred — but project delivery track record matters most
